title: XOM Boosts Angola Prospects With Kizomba Redevelopment & New Discovery - TradingView
content: ExxonMobil Holdings Corporation XOM and its partners in Block 15 offshore Angola have reached a final investment decision (FIDs) for the redevelopment of the Kizomba A and B oil fields. The partners have approved an approximately $4 billion investment to extend the productive life of these fields and develop the Likembe field. The project is expected to utilize the existing infrastructure across the Kizomba hub. This approach will reduce the need for new infrastructure and allow the ExxonMobil-led group to bring additional resources into production across the Kizomba Pole region. Angola's National Oil, Gas and Biofuels Agency (ANPG) noted that with this latest investment approval, the FIDs related to the Block 15 Life Extension Project have been completed. The decision follows the approval of the Kizomba C redevelopment project in 2025. Separately, ExxonMobil and its partners announced a new hydrocarbon discovery at the Tchihumba West-01ST1 exploration well. The exploration well found 65.4 meters of sandstone reservoir containing hydrocarbons. The reservoir reportedly exhibited good petrophysical properties, indicating potentially favorable porosity and permeability. The new hydrocarbon find was the 21stin Block 15, per data from the ANPG. This demonstrates the offshore block’s untapped potential to support future production in the region. An ExxonMobil spokesperson said the company intends to maximize production and recovery from existing resources and unlock new development opportunities through investments, technological progress and exploration. The developments in Angola’s offshore Block 15 follow the extension of the Block 15 Production Sharing Agreement (“PSA”) through 2037. The extension of the PSA, along with $4 billion in investments, which include the Likembe field development and the Block 15 Life Extension Project, is expected to boost Angola’s energy sector while supporting long-term production and value creation for the company and partners in the block. The latest exploration discovery, the extension of the production sharing agreement and the redevelopment plan for Kizomba A and B strengthen ExxonMobil's long-term foothold in Angola. It provides opportunities to sustain production from existing fields, add new resources and maximize the value of its existing production facilities and infrastructure.
